Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.extension

Schnittstelle NpcExtension

public interface NpcExtension
A unit of functionality another plugin adds to BetterNPCs.

An extension is not a plugin. It is a small object a plugin registers so that BetterNPCs can tell it when to set up and tear down, and so that its handlers, providers and rules are unregistered together when it goes away. A plugin that only wants to add one action handler does not need one — ActionRegistry takes it directly. An extension pays for itself once a plugin registers several related things, or once it needs to be reloadable.

The engine also uses extensions to sequence startup: dependencies() is honoured, so a shop extension can rely on a dialog extension having been enabled first regardless of the order the two plugins loaded in.

  • Methodendetails

    • id

      String id()
      Returns a stable id, unique among registered extensions.

      Used in log messages, in /npc extensions, and as the target of another extension's dependencies(). Namespace it with the owning plugin's name.

      Gibt zurück:
      the id

    • version

      default String version()
      Returns a human-readable version, shown in diagnostics.
      Gibt zurück:
      the version; "unknown" by default

    • dependencies

      default Set<String> dependencies()
      Returns the ids of extensions that must be enabled before this one.

      An extension whose dependencies are not registered stays pending rather than failing, and is enabled as soon as they arrive. One whose dependencies never arrive is reported at the end of startup, so a missing plugin produces a clear message rather than silence.

      Gibt zurück:
      the required extension ids; empty by default

    • onEnable

      void onEnable(BetterNPCsApi api)
      Sets the extension up.

      Called on the main thread, after BetterNPCs is fully initialised and after every dependency has been enabled. Register action handlers, skin providers and visibility rules here rather than in the owning plugin's onEnable, so that they are re-registered correctly if the extension is reloaded.

      Throwing marks the extension as failed: it is not enabled, anything depending on it is not enabled either, and the failure is logged with the extension id. It does not stop BetterNPCs.

      Parameter:
      api - the API to register against

    • onDisable

      default void onDisable()
      Tears the extension down.

      Called on the main thread when the extension is unregistered or BetterNPCs shuts down, and before any of its dependencies are disabled. Handlers, providers and rules registered during onEnable(BetterNPCsApi) are removed automatically; this is for anything else, such as a scheduled task or an external connection.
